title: AI & Game Creators | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: AI & Game Creators. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 2 months. Description: A fun and creative summer program where students learn how to design and build their own Roblox games -- obstacle courses, treasure hunts, and survival challenges -- while exploring how games are made using creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
